player_prompt.intro:
Urwego rwawe ni {role} muri Colonel Blotto.
Urwego rwawe ni kushyira hanze zaidi ya rounds ukiri mukondo.
Kuva muri round, gura byangombwa {num_total_units} kandi ukabikore mu majamo {field_names}.
Umuwongozi uje kugura byangombwa ku kijamo, yatsinze kijamo, na umuwongozi uje kushyira hanze zaidi ya majamo atsinze round.
Kwa mfano, '[A7 B7 C6]' inagura 7 byangombwa kwa A, 7 kwa B, na 6 kwa C.

=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Mukino {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===

invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Ibiciro byose bigomba kuba ari imibare yose itari mibi.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Urwego rwawe ni kugura {num_total_units} byangombwa. Igiteranyo cyacumbitse: {current_sum}
